title: Population, Surface Area, Open Defecation, And Displacement Diverged
hook: A bigger world gained safer cities while displacement kept surging.
closing: Population and land help only when systems turn them into human safety.
question: Which human-security shift surprised you?

segments.say: Working-age population reached 5.36 billion. More people now depend on systems that convert scale into security.
Russian Federation spans 17.1 million square kilometers. Vast national space alone does not guarantee people safer lives.
Urban open defecation fell to 0.69 percent. Public systems can turn population scale into real security.
Forcibly displaced people reached 117.3 million. Population and land still fail when people cannot remain at home.
